question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH sales_by_region_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(s.qty) AS 销量
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        sku_name,
        销量,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY 销量 DESC) AS rn
    FROM sales_by_region_sku
)
SELECT 
    region AS 大区,
    sku_name AS 单品
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.brand,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS brand_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY p.brand
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
    bs.brand
FROM brand_sales bs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
WHERE bs.brand_net_amount / NULLIF(ts.total_net_amount, 0) > 0.10

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数
FROM (
    SELECT s.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
    HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > (
        SELECT SUM(s2.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s2.outlet_id), 0)
        FROM fact_sales s2
        JOIN dim_date d2 ON s2.date_key = d2.date_key
        WHERE d2.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    )
) t

question: 每个品类销量最高的三个单品
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 销量,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY p.category, p.sku_name
)
SELECT category, sku_name, 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY category, 销量 DESC

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.category AS 品类,
        d.year_month AS 年月,
        SUM(s.qty) AS 销量
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY p.category, d.year_month
)
SELECT
    a.品类
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b ON a.品类 = b.品类 AND a.年月 = '2026-08' AND b.年月 = '2026-07'
WHERE a.销量 > b.销量

    GROUP BY dl.region

total_sales AS (

    FROM region_sales
)

终端 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id)::DOUBLE AS 有效终端数
    FROM dim_outlet o
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON o.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE dl.region = '华东'
      AND o.is_active = TRUE
),
动销 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (s.outlet_id, s.sku_id))::DOUBLE AS 动销组合数
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON o.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE dl.region = '华东'
      AND d.year_month = '2026-08'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT 已铺货终端数 FROM 铺货) / NULLIF((SELECT 有效终端数 FROM 终端), 0) AS 铺市率,
    (SELECT 动销组合数 FROM 动销) / NULLIF((SELECT 铺货组合数 FROM 铺货), 0) AS 动销率

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS active_days
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
monthly_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM fact_inventory i
    JOIN dim_date d ON i.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY i.dealer_id, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    mi.dealer_id,
    mi.total_on_hand / NULLIF(ms.total_qty / NULLIF(ms.active_days, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM monthly_inventory mi
LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON mi.dealer_id = ms.dealer_id AND mi.year_month = ms.year_month
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.region
),
previous_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS previous_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.region, p.region) AS 大区,
    (c.current_net_amount - p.previous_net_amount) / NULLIF(p.previous_net_amount, 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM current_period c
LEFT JOIN previous_period p ON c.region = p.region
ORDER BY 大区

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_month AS (
    SELECT
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS 单店产出
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_year_month AS (
    SELECT
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS 单店产出
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(c.channel, l.channel) AS 渠道,
    COALESCE(c.单店产出, 0) - COALESCE(l.单店产出, 0) AS 单店产出变化
FROM current_month c
FULL JOIN last_year_month l ON c.channel = l.channel
ORDER BY 渠道

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo = TRUE
    AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
sc AS (
  SELECT s.year_month, s.amt / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS 费效比
  FROM s
  JOIN c ON s.year_month = c.year_month
)
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(费效比) FROM sc WHERE year_month LIKE '2026%') -
  (SELECT AVG(费效比) FROM sc WHERE year_month LIKE '2025%') AS 费效比差值
